places: often regarded as being on Diego Garcia

fields.climate: tropical marine; hot, humid, moderated by trade winds
fields.terrain: flat and low coral atolls (most areas do not exceed 2 m, or 6.6 ft, in elevation); sits atop the submarine volcanic Chagos-Laccadive Ridge
fields.hazards: none; located outside routes of Indian Ocean cyclones
fields.legal: the laws of the UK apply
